about_the_game:
A Psychological Horror Based on a True Story

Trust Me puts you in the shoes of someone living through a terrifying night. After visiting his mother’s house, the protagonist sets off on a journey home — only to encounter chilling and inexplicable events. This story is inspired by real-life experiences, adding a disturbing sense of realism to every moment.

Immersive First-Person Experience

With a slow-paced, tension-driven design, Trust Me focuses on atmospheric storytelling and realistic interactions. Players explore their surroundings, make environmental observations, and witness the unsettling unraveling of the protagonist’s reality — all from a first-person perspective.

Key Features

  • 2000s Retro Horror Feel: VHS-style visuals, analog interference, and period-accurate scenery.

  • Creeping Audio Design: Echoes, silence, ambient noise — every sound builds tension.

  • Psychological Depth: A surreal journey into fear, memory, and mental distortion.

  • Journey Through Isolation: From driving scenes to eerie, empty spaces — expect dread at every turn.

  • Inspired by True Events: The story draws directly from real-world incidents.

Who Is This Game For?

Perfect for players who love psychological horror, eerie environments, and slow-burning tension. Streamers and content creators will find plenty of material for reaction-filled moments, while horror fans will appreciate the unsettling authenticity.

Visual Style

The game features a distinct blend of 3D environments with a retro aesthetic. VHS glitch effects, low lighting, and nostalgic visuals combine with subtle realism to create a unique atmosphere reminiscent of found-footage horror from the late 20th century.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains sudden jumpscares, a dark and intense atmosphere, and a horror story inspired by real-life events. It may be disturbing to some players.
